## About Digital Realty Trust (NYSE:DLR)

Digital Realty Trust, Inc is a real estate investment trust that owns, operates and develops data center facilities for businesses, cloud service providers, information technology companies and telecommunications organizations.  The company provides the physical infrastructure needed to support data storage, networking, cloud computing and other digital operations. 

Its services include data center colocation, interconnection and private connectivity solutions.

noticias.titulo: Alphabet, Amazon, Meta Report Negative Free Cash Flow After Heavy AI Investment - Bloomberg
noticias.resumo:
# AI Enthusiasm Is Collapsing and Tech Earnings Just Made It Worse

The last two weeks were supposed to bring some clarity to a stock market wobbling on a series of risks, particularly doubts about heavy spending on artificial intelligence, as a series of technology giants reported their earnings. 

After seeing the numbers, the outlook is clearer.  Unfortunately for Wall Street, it’s also considerably darker.
